//! @generated — layout deterministik. Satu aturan saja: semua `rect` di IR
//! relatif terhadap induk; hasil layout selalu absolut di viewport.

use crate::component::{Component, Kind, Node, NodeId};
use crate::core::{Axis, Point, Rect, Size};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct Layout {
    pub rects: BTreeMap<NodeId, Rect>,
    /// Urutan gambar (depth-first). Dipakai hit-test dari teratas.
    pub order: Vec<NodeId>,
    pub scale: f32,
    pub offset: Point,
}

impl Layout {
    pub fn get(&self, id: NodeId) -> Option<Rect> {
        self.rects.get(&id).copied()
    }
}

/// Skema viewport: desain diskalakan seragam dan dilebarkan di tengah
/// (letterbox), sehingga tidak pernah ada distorsi saat jendela di-resize.
pub fn compute(component: &Component, viewport: Size) -> Layout {
    let design = component.design_size.clamped();
    let view = viewport.clamped();
    let scale = (view.width / design.width)
        .min(view.height / design.height)
        .max(0.01);
    let offset = Point::new(
        (view.width - design.width * scale) / 2.0,
        (view.height - design.height * scale) / 2.0,
    );

    let mut layout = Layout {
        rects: BTreeMap::new(),
        order: Vec::new(),
        scale,
        offset,
    };
    for root in &component.root {
        if !root.visible {
            continue;
        }
        let rect = Rect::new(
            offset.x + root.rect.origin.x * scale,
            offset.y + root.rect.origin.y * scale,
            root.rect.size.width * scale,
            root.rect.size.height * scale,
        );
        place(root, rect, scale, &mut layout);
    }
    layout
}

fn place(node: &Node, rect: Rect, scale: f32, layout: &mut Layout) {
    layout.rects.insert(node.id, rect);
    layout.order.push(node.id);
    place_children(node, rect, scale, layout);
}

fn place_children(node: &Node, rect: Rect, scale: f32, layout: &mut Layout) {
    let axis = match &node.kind {
        Kind::Frame(spec) => spec.layout,
        _ => Axis::None,
    };
    if axis == Axis::None {
        for child in &node.children {
            if !child.visible {
                continue;
            }
            let child_rect = Rect::new(
                rect.origin.x + child.rect.origin.x * scale,
                rect.origin.y + child.rect.origin.y * scale,
                child.rect.size.width * scale,
                child.rect.size.height * scale,
            );
            place(child, child_rect, scale, layout);
        }
        return;
    }

    let (padding_start, padding_cross, gap) = match &node.kind {
        Kind::Frame(spec) => {
            let start = if axis == Axis::Horizontal {
                spec.padding.left
            } else {
                spec.padding.top
            };
            let cross = if axis == Axis::Horizontal {
                spec.padding.top
            } else {
                spec.padding.left
            };
            (start * scale, cross * scale, spec.gap.max(0.0) * scale)
        }
        _ => (0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
    };

    let mut cursor = match axis {
        Axis::Horizontal => rect.origin.x + padding_start,
        Axis::Vertical => rect.origin.y + padding_start,
        Axis::None => 0.0,
    };

    for child in &node.children {
        if !child.visible {
            continue;
        }
        let width = child.rect.size.width * scale;
        let height = child.rect.size.height * scale;
        let child_rect = match axis {
            Axis::Horizontal => Rect::new(
                cursor,
                rect.origin.y + padding_cross + child.rect.origin.y * scale,
                width,
                height,
            ),
            Axis::Vertical => Rect::new(
                rect.origin.x + padding_cross + child.rect.origin.x * scale,
                cursor,
                width,
                height,
            ),
            Axis::None => Rect::new(cursor, rect.origin.y + padding_cross, width, height),
        };
        place(child, child_rect, scale, layout);
        cursor += if axis == Axis::Horizontal { width } else { height } + gap;
    }
}

/// Kembalikan node teratas yang mengandung titik (dalam koordinat viewport).
pub fn hit_test(layout: &Layout, point: Point) -> Option<NodeId> {
    for id in layout.order.iter().rev() {
        if let Some(rect) = layout.rects.get(id) {
            if rect.contains(point) {
                return Some(*id);
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::component::{FrameSpec, Padding, Style};
    use crate::core::{Align, Color};

    fn frame(id: NodeId, x: f32, y: f32, w: f32, h: f32, children: Vec<Node>) -> Node {
        Node {
            id,
            name: format!("frame-{id}"),
            rect: Rect::new(x, y, w, h),
            style: Style::default(),
            kind: Kind::Frame(FrameSpec {
                layout: Axis::None,
                gap: 0.0,
                padding: Padding::default(),
                align: Align::Start,
            }),
            visible: true,
            locked: false,
            children,
        }
    }

    fn shape(id: NodeId, x: f32, y: f32, w: f32, h: f32) -> Node {
        Node {
            id,
            name: format!("shape-{id}"),
            rect: Rect::new(x, y, w, h),
            style: Style::default(),
            kind: Kind::Shape(crate::component::ShapeKind::Rectangle),
            visible: true,
            locked: false,
            children: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn absolute_and_relative_layout() {
        let component = Component {
            name: "test".into(),
            design_size: Size::new(100.0, 100.0),
            root: vec![frame(1, 10.0, 20.0, 80.0, 60.0, vec![shape(2, 5.0, 7.0, 10.0, 10.0)])],
            assets: Vec::new(),
        };
        let layout = compute(&component, Size::new(100.0, 100.0));
        assert_eq!(layout.get(1), Some(Rect::new(10.0, 20.0, 80.0, 60.0)));
        assert_eq!(layout.get(2), Some(Rect::new(15.0, 27.0, 10.0, 10.0)));
        assert_eq!(hit_test(&layout, Point::new(16.0, 28.0)), Some(2));
        assert_eq!(hit_test(&layout, Point::new(99.0, 99.0)), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn auto_layout_applies_padding_and_gap() {
        let mut parent = frame(1, 0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0, vec![shape(2, 0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0), shape(3, 0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0)]);
        if let Kind::Frame(spec) = &mut parent.kind {
            spec.layout = Axis::Horizontal;
            spec.padding = Padding::uniform(5.0);
            spec.gap = 10.0;
        }
        let _ = Color::BLACK;
        let component = Component {
            name: "test".into(),
            design_size: Size::new(100.0, 100.0),
            root: vec![parent],
            assets: Vec::new(),
        };
        let layout = compute(&component, Size::new(100.0, 100.0));
        assert_eq!(layout.get(2), Some(Rect::new(5.0, 5.0, 10.0, 10.0)));
        assert_eq!(layout.get(3), Some(Rect::new(25.0, 5.0, 10.0, 10.0)));
    }
}
